# Adventure Dental

> Adventure Dental is a pediatric dentistry and orthodontics practice in Vancouver, WA, serving children, teens, and adults with comprehensive dental care and smile alignment solutions.

Adventure Dental specializes in pediatric dentistry and orthodontic treatment across all age groups, featuring a team of board-certified dentists and orthodontists. The practice offers both traditional braces and Invisalign clear aligners, with a focus on making dental care accessible and comfortable for young patients.

## Orthodontic Services

- [Orthodontics](https://adventuredental.com/orthodontics): Orthodontics services including Invisalign and braces for all ages
- [Invisalign](https://adventuredental.com/invisalign): Invisalign clear aligners as alternative to braces with 3D imaging
- [Braces](https://adventuredental.com/braces): Metal braces and Invisalign teeth straightening options explained
- [Orthodontics for Kids](https://adventuredental.com/orthodontic-for-kids): Orthodontic evaluation and treatment for children with early intervention
- [Orthodontics for Teens](https://adventuredental.com/orthodontics-for-teens): Braces and Invisalign options for teenagers' smile confidence
- [Orthodontics for Adults](https://adventuredental.com/orthodontics-for-adults): Adult orthodontic treatment with braces and Invisalign alternatives
